name: pianosim
description: Pure-Rust modal physical-modeling piano synthesizer and Web AudioWorklet studio

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --package piano-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && mkdir -p apps/web/public && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/piano_wasm.wasm apps/web/public/piano_wasm.wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:web
